description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sphinx of False Conclusions, adding {C}{C}.
When Sphinx of False Conclusions dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Sphinx of False Conclusions trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Sphinx of False Conclusions from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
